## Problem and outcome

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue; use `Closes #...` only when this PR fully resolves it.

## Verification

State what was checked and the actual result. Include relevant game-rule, concurrency, reconnect, or device scenarios. For documentation-only changes, state the document checks performed.

## Visual evidence

For visual changes, embed screenshots or a concise recording showing the changed behavior, and link the same evidence in the issue. Follow docs/development-workflow.md: recordings should show smooth, direct actions with setup and long idle gaps removed. Identify the device/viewport and explain what to observe. For changes with no visual effect, state "Not applicable."

## Remaining limitations

Describe material limitations or unresolved follow-up work, or remove this section.
